verdict.rationale: Plugging in MCP servers is an MCP-client role, which belongs to AI agents and assistants. VirtualPostMail is a virtual mailbox and address-compliance service with no agent or LLM runtime that could consume external tools. Its only programmatic surfaces are Zapier and an API gated behind a contact request, and neither involves using other servers' tools, so this axis does not apply to its product type.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
